description: This file defines a React component 'EmbedComponent' for rendering embedded content such as iframes, including handling of Twitter and YouTube embeds, with resizing and styling features.

methods.name: getSandboxFeatures
methods.description: Generates sandbox attribute features for iframe based on URL protocol.

methods.name: isYouTubeEmbed
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a YouTube embed URL.

methods.name: isTwitterX
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a Twitter or X embed URL.

methods.name: tweetToEmbed
methods.description: Converts a Twitter/X URL into an embeddable blockquote HTML string.
